findings.message: The track.file guard only rejects separators recognized by the host Path class. On POSIX a backslash is a legal filename character, so a metadata file containing ..\\track.wav is accepted and points at a literal backslash name, while Windows rejects it. Reject both separators explicitly so the same evidence is safe on every platform.

findings.message: When more than one take is rendered, _record_history re-reads the selected muse.json and lets OSError or JSONDecodeError escape. A successful composition can therefore end in a traceback if the just-written evidence is unreadable or corrupted. Wrap the read and parse in MuseError with What/Why/Fix so the CLI reports a clean failure.
